RESOURCE.name: Suaru HSC Field of View
RESOURCE.DESCRIPTION: The Hyper Suprime-Cam (HSC) is a gigantic mosaic CCD camera, which is attached at the prime focus of Subaru Telescope. The HSC uses 104 main science CCDs, which covers 1.5 deg FoV in diameter with a pixel scale of 0.17", as well as 4 CCDs for auto guider, and 8 CCDs for auto focus.
